title: Valley Vista 1.5 Hour Horseback Trail Ride in Kananaskis
includes: Use of horse and all necessary equipment
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children 17 years of age and younger MUST BE accompanied by their parent or legal guardian
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
This Ride is ONE of a kind!!

This one and a half hour ride is ideal for those ready to graduate from our one hour Buffalo Loop but are not quite ready for our two hour Ridge Ride! Start your journey travelling through our aspen grove before climbing your way up past our pond with stunning views of Mount Kidd. After reaching the top you will traverse down our rock cut before winding your way through the Lodgepole Pines to our herd of Buffalo. Appropriate for novice to experienced riders!

Ride Departure Times: 9am & 11am
*Please arrive 45-30 minutes prior to ride departure
